scenarios.name: sketch-visibility-01 Hide surrounding model while retaining active sketch display

scenario_steps.name: a sketch is active with surrounding model shading visible
Hide Others is available in the empty-canvas context menu
the active sketch outlines remain visible
the surrounding model browser entries appear dim
the user reopens the context menu
Show All is available and Hide Others is disabled
Hide Others has been applied in the fixture sketch
the surrounding model browser entries appear dim
the user opens the empty-canvas context menu and choose Show All
surrounding model shading is visible again
the browser entries return to their earlier appearance
the user reopens the context menu
Show All is disabled and Hide Others is available
the menu closes and restored visibility remains
